body: Code changes: +904 -14\ Tests: +441 -2\ Others: +0 -0 ## What When an over-the-air update finishes downloading, the mobile app shows a full-screen **Update ready** screen with Ruto, the Orchestrator mascot, quietly alive: - **Idle:** Ruto breathes, blinks at irregular moments, and a sheen passes over it now and then. - **Tap Ruto:** a small squish. - **Restart:** a brighter sheen, a nod with eyes closed and one success haptic, then Ruto and the words fade into the restart. - **Restart to update** restarts the app into the new bundle and reopens the page you were on. - **Not now** (or Android back) returns to the app. The app never restarts on its own. ## Why Before this, a downloaded update was applied silently. After 15+ minutes in the background, the next resume called `reloadAsync()` with no warning. The JS restarted at the root route, so someone in the middle of a chat landed back on the board. The only manual path was the "Ready — tap to restart" row in Settings. ## Before / After Both captures: Settings → Theme, dark mode, iOS simulator (iPhone 17 Pro, iOS 26.5), same 2.4.0 Release binary with the JS bundle swapped. Theme is opened by in-app navigation, not a deep link, because expo-router reopens the last deep link after a reload. The simulator isn't paired, so a Settings page stands in for a chat. Every page goes through the same path. | Before | After | | --- | --- | | | | | Restarts on its own after a long absence, with no screen, and lands on the board | Ruto waits, quietly alive, and reacts to a tap. **Restart to update** nods, fades and reopens the same page | | No way to put an update off | | ## How - **`UpdateMascot.tsx` / `rutoArt.ts` / `updateMascotPose.ts`:** - Ruto is drawn from the brand source, `assets/brand/ruto.svg`, the same art behind the app icon and the onboarding mascot, rendered with `SvgXml`. - The brand file's `defs`, `baton` and `body` groups are copied verbatim into `rutoArt.ts`. `rutoArt.source.test.ts` fails if they drift from the brand file. - The baton is its own layer behind the body, as in the source, and barely sways while its tip glows. Face-coloured lids drop over the eye holes to blink. - The sheen is a gradient band clipped to Ruto's outline (`RUTO_OUTLINE`, read from the same defs), animated through Reanimated animated props, so it only ever lights Ruto. - Chosen from four interactive prototypes: conductor, special delivery, build the new version, and quiet. Quiet is the restrained one and the closest to DESIGN.md's "motion is functional and modest". It is still a character rather than a loop: a quiet idle layer plus small reactions, the way character apps build mascots. - Tap: a small squish and a light haptic. Restart: one brighter sheen, a nod with eyes closed (the only success haptic), and Ruto and the words fade together. `RESTART_HOLD_MS` is the finale's 1.2 s, so the reload follows the nod. - Idle runs on one Reanimated clock (a 7.2 s loop); the tap and the finale run on their own progress values. The choreography is pure worklet functions, unit-tested for a seamless loop, irregular blinks, the sheen's sweep, small motion ranges and the finale's shape. With Reduce Motion on, Ruto stands still and the finale is only the fade. - **`UpdateScreen.tsx` / `updateScreenState.ts`:** a `Modal`, so it also covers the Settings form sheet. Its state is a small external store with two phases, `ready` and `restarting`. Once a restart has started, a late offer or Not now can't interrupt it. The buttons and the progress line swap visibility, not layout, so the mascot doesn't move when Restart is tapped. - **`UpdatesManager.tsx`:** - Offers each downloaded update once, keyed by update id. That covers the native launch download, a resume check and a manual check in Settings. - Holds the offer during onboarding and pairing (`/onboarding`, `/pair`) and shows it once the user leaves. - The long-resume path used to call `reloadAsync()` itself; it now offers the update again instead. `onForeground` returns `"prompt"` where it returned `"reload"`. - **`UpdateRouteKeeper.tsx` / `updateResume*.ts`:** - Tracks the current page. A sheet (the `sheets/` group, plus conversation actions, the files review sheet and new cloud project), onboarding, pairing or manual connect leaves the page underneath as the one to restore. - Saves the page to AsyncStorage right before the reload and reopens it once afterwards, as soon as navigation is ready: pushed over the board, or replacing the stale deep-link page the reload came back on. Routes are compared as full hrefs, so the same session on another machine counts as a different page. - It doesn't wait for the machine to answer. Pages already handle a machine that is still loading, as a cold-start notification tap does. The first move away from the page the reload landed on cancels the restore for good, even if the user comes back, so it never replaces a page they chose. - A saved page older than 2 minutes is ignored. - **Settings:** "Ready — tap to restart" goes through the same restart, so it gets the screen and returns to Settings. All JS: no native, `package.json` or plugin changes, so this ships over the air on the current runtime. ## Testing - `npx tsc --noEmit` (packages/mobile): clean. - `npx vitest run` (packages/mobile): 467 files, 4684 tests passing. New tests: - choreography: seamless loop, irregular blinks, the sheen sweep, small motion ranges, the tap squish, the finale (sheen, nod with eyes closed at the haptic, full fade), and a still pose for Reduce Motion - Ruto markup identical to `assets/brand/ruto.svg`, and its outline exposed for the sheen clip - screen state: offering never reloads, Not now can't interrupt a restart, a failed reload takes the screen down - offer-once rule, held during onboarding and pairing - the route keeper itself (stayed, left and came back while storage was pending, still away, nothing saved) - route classification, restore action (including the dropped restore once the user has moved), and stale or malformed saved records - iOS simulator, Release 2.4.0 binary with the branch bundle swapped in: ready screen in light and dark, Restart, Not now, and the restart reopening Settings → Theme. Shown in the GIFs above. - Not tested: a real OTA download from the update server, and Android. ## Checklist - [x] Branched from `main` (or continuing an existing PR branch) - [x] One focused change; links the related issue when applicable - [x] Follows [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/OrchestratorInc/agent-orchestrator/blob/main/AGENTS.md) conventions and PR hygiene - [x] Before / After filled in; UI changes include screenshots or a recording - [x] Tests added/updated for user-visible behavior where it makes sense - [ ] Relevant CI checks pass for the area touched (`go`, frontend, etc.)
title: feat(mobile): animated mascot screen offering a downloaded OTA update
